$doc: Player abilities (hero skills, airstrikes, spells). cooldown s; target: point (aim at ground), self (around hero) or global. mode defaults to manual; automatic picks the densest enemy group. Effects: damage + damageType, stun, freeze, slow {amount, duration}, burn {dps, duration}, mark {amount, duration} (area, radius), chain {count, falloff, range} (from the enemy nearest the point), knockback m (ground, bosses 25%), reveal (strips stealth), shieldBreak 0-1 (bosses half), execute (non-boss below that health share), allies {count, unit} (on the nearest road), towerBuff {rate, damage, duration}, healBase (keep health), cash.

abilities.name: Airstrike
abilities.description: Call in a jet strike on a point after 1.5 s.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.description: Freezes every enemy in a wide circle for 2.5 s.

abilities.name: Commander's Rally
abilities.description: Towers near the Commander attack 35% faster for 8 s.

abilities.name: Artillery Barrage
abilities.description: A wide shell barrage lands on a point after 2.2 s.

abilities.name: Field Repairs
abilities.description: Engineers patch the keep: restores 20 keep health.

abilities.name: War Chest
abilities.description: Requisitioned funds: +120 cash.

abilities.name: Gravity Well
abilities.description: Warps space: enemies in the area are halved in speed for 5 s.

abilities.name: Starfall
abilities.description: A falling star strikes one spot after 1.2 s: built for bosses and elites.

abilities.name: Banner of Valor
abilities.description: Towers near the Commander deal 30% more damage for 8 s.

abilities.name: Flare Shells
abilities.description: Flares burn away stealth and mark every enemy in the area: +25% damage taken for 6 s.

abilities.name: Arcane Chain
abilities.description: A bolt strikes the enemy nearest the point and jumps to 7 more.

abilities.name: Meteor
abilities.description: A meteor lands after 1.6 s and leaves the ground burning.

abilities.name: Wall of Flame
abilities.description: Sets a wide area ablaze: 30 fire damage per second for 6 s.

abilities.name: Kindle
abilities.description: Nearby towers burn hotter: +20% damage and +20% attack speed for 8 s.

abilities.name: Flashfire
abilities.description: A blast wave that throws ground enemies 4 m back along the road (bosses 1 m).

abilities.name: Reinforcements
abilities.description: Three riflemen drop onto the road nearest the point and hold it.

abilities.name: Frag Volley
abilities.description: Grenades knock ground enemies 3 m back (bosses less).

abilities.name: Overclock
abilities.description: Nearby towers fire 50% faster for 6 s.

abilities.name: Supply Drop
abilities.description: A crate with +80 cash and spare parts for the keep (+8 health).

abilities.name: Entangling Roots
abilities.description: Roots hold every enemy in the area for 2 s (bosses 0.5 s).

abilities.name: Spirit Pack
abilities.description: Two spirit wolves leap onto the road nearest the point.

abilities.name: Cleansing Bloom
abilities.description: Strips shields (bosses half) and stealth in a wide area.

abilities.name: Verdant Renewal
abilities.description: Restores 12 keep health and quickens nearby towers by 15% for 10 s.

abilities.name: Marked for Death
abilities.description: A spotter round: 120 damage and +40% damage taken for 8 s.

abilities.name: EMP Burst
abilities.description: Fries shields (bosses half) and stuns for 1.2 s.

abilities.name: Recon Drone
abilities.description: A drone sweep: reveals stealth and marks a huge area (+15% damage taken for 10 s).

abilities.name: Headhunter
abilities.description: Finishes every non-boss below 25% health in the area, then 150 damage.
